message.text:
The scheduler package is not imported outside itself. The memopayload runner exists but is not started by the server; only RebuildMemoPayload is used inline during create and update operations.

Checking whether the notification dispatcher, webhook workers, SSE, email dispatcher, and markdown runners start at server startup. Webhook workers initialize via package init() rather than startBackgroundRunners, so their inclusion depends on whether the server imports the webhook package. Email and markdown workers still need verification.

message.text:
The server explicitly starts only the s3presign runner. It runs via a time.Ticker every 12 hours plus a RunOnce call at startup.

The webhook package spawns four goroutines on import for async delivery. They drain a channel and run event-driven. The server does not start them directly.

memopayload.Runner is never started; only RebuildMemoPayload is invoked inline.

The internal/scheduler package contains cron infrastructure but is unused by the server.

SSE hub is request-driven and not a scheduled background runner.

message.text:
The internal/scheduler package is completely isolated and unused. The memopayload runner is not started. Webhook workers begin automatically when their packages are imported during server startup.

s3presign runs once immediately at startup, then repeats on a 12-hour ticker. The four webhook async workers launch on package initialization and consume events from a channel; they are not scheduled by any timer.

q28.
s3presign — `Server.startBackgroundRunners` in `server/server.go`: `RunOnce` at start, then `time.Ticker` every 12h (`server/runner/s3presign/runner.go`)
webhook async workers — `init()` in `internal/webhook/webhook.go`: 4 goroutines drain `asyncPostQueue` (event-driven, not scheduled)

Unused infra: `internal/scheduler` (cron) is never imported or started by the server. `server/runner/memopayload` exists (`NewRunner`/`RunOnce`) but is not started; only `RebuildMemoPayload` runs inline on create/update.
